title: Liquid record
description: Pink lacquer grooves turn and ripple around a small record label.
useCase: Music artwork, material experiments, and motion states for a media interface.
interaction: Change ripple intensity or pause the record motion
reducedMotion: Both rotation and vector ripple updates stop. Ripple intensity remains adjustable.
limitations: Visual record motion only; no audio, track playback or audio-reactive analysis.
look: Deep plum field with a large wobbly pink vinyl record, fine magenta grooves and pale label, beside a two-line pink serif headline.
motion: Each frame the disc's paths are re-plotted with drifting sine displacement so 48 grooves wobble like liquid; the label marks spin every 14 s and a slider sets ripple strength.
adapt: Deformation is `ripplePoint` (sine-cosine offsets scaled by `amount`), applied by `groovePath` to every `data-radius` path in a `requestAnimationFrame` loop; the label spin is `sf-liquid-spin` (14 s linear). Tune `ripple` (0–38) and the frequencies; replace the headline and palette.
